verified_against_binary: v2.36.2 is a CLARITY pass with no fact changes: every claim, tier, caveat and evidence date is unchanged from v2.36.1. A reader review found that the site named no concrete identifier anywhere -- across all 11 pages, zero mentions of the plugin-root token, the detection environment variables, the session path shape, or the shell tool's Cowork name. Rules told an author what to do while withholding what the thing IS, which is agreeable and unactionable. Root cause: the project's portability instruction -- do not hard-code delivery tool names, because that pins a skill to one runtime -- had been over-generalised into 'name nothing'. Those are different concerns; the scope is now confirmed as DELIVERY TOOLS ONLY. Ten facts now name the thing: `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`; the ordered detection sequence (CLAUDE_CODE_IS_COWORK, then a working directory under /sessions/, then CLAUDECODE); 'runtime marker' defined as an environment variable the host sets at spawn; the shell tool named on both sides (mcp__workspace__bash vs Bash); the two execution contexts named (agent context vs shell context); the session path shape shown as /sessions/<session-name>/mnt/outputs/report.pdf; the three concrete ways to pass configuration into a sealed shell; and the preinstalled inventory published (Python 3.10.12, ~149 packages, pandas/numpy/PIL/openpyxl). Delivery guidance moved the OTHER way, back to the general instruction -- 'present it to the user' rather than 'whichever delivery tool the session offers', which was both vague and still tool-shaped. Vocabulary unified: the reader-facing prose said 'lane' while the badges said 'sandbox'; 'lane' is gone from every rule, detail, caveat, page summary and open question. The `lane` schema field keeps its name -- it is internal. Disclosure lint stays clean; the identifiers now published were already on its two-clause allowlist and had simply never been used in prose.
note: No re-verification was performed and no `verified` stamp moved: the evidence date is unchanged at 2026-08-05. Lesson count, chapter count, registry baseline and the fcache pin are all unchanged.
